fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: When disabled, devices are refused and no jobs are handed out.

fields.label: Auto-approve New Devices
fields.description: Off (recommended): a manager must approve each new computer before it can send or receive.

fields.label: Default Country Code
fields.description: Digits only. Prepended to 10-digit numbers that have no country code.

fields.label: Job Poll Interval (seconds)
fields.description: Fallback polling. Devices are also woken instantly over Frappe realtime.

fields.label: Job Lease (seconds)
fields.description: A claimed job returns to the queue if the device does not report a result in time.

fields.label: Import Chat History (days)
fields.description: When a WhatsApp account is linked, import messages from the last N days. 0 = contacts only. More than 90 requests the full history from the phone (slower).

fields.label: Media Download
fields.description: On Request: photos, videos, voice notes and documents are not copied to ERPNext until someone clicks Download in WhatsApp Chat; the computer where the user is logged in then fetches it from WhatsApp. Automatic: every file is copied when the message arrives (uses much more disk space).

fields.label: Download Media in History
fields.description: Only with Media Download = Automatic: also copy the files of imported chat history.

fields.label: Realtime URL (optional)
fields.description: Leave empty when ERPNext is behind nginx (the normal production setup). For a development bench, enter the socket.io address, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:9000

fields.label: Service User
fields.description: Internal user that enrolled devices act as. Created automatically.

fields.label: Send WhatsApp automatically
fields.description: When a document of these types is created, submitted or cancelled (Send When), a WhatsApp message goes to its mobile number - from the WhatsApp number of the user who did it, or else the default sending account. A comment on the document shows the result.
